summary: Code for GovTech (C4GT) is India's first dedicated mentoring program for building and contributing to Digital Public Goods. Its Dedicated Mentoring Program (DMP) connects contributors with Tech-for-Good organizations to build production-ready solutions with experienced mentors.

stipend.detail: DMP contributors earn a stipend of Rs. 1 lakh over the 3-month program. C4GT co-funds 50% of the stipend with the participating organization.

facts.label: Mentoring
facts.value: 1:1 mentorship from domain experts at partner organizations

facts.label: Domain
facts.value: Digital Public Goods, Digital Public Infrastructure and Tech for Good

eligibility: Open to talent interested in Tech for Good, particularly students and young professionals.
Pick a listed DMP project and meet the skills it asks for.
howToApply: Go through the DMP project list on the C4GT GitHub wiki.
Follow the instructions on Apna to apply before the deadline.
If your proposal is shortlisted, the organization may invite you to an interview.
